g.text: TUSB320LAI presents sink terminations and reports advertised current over I2C. No PD.

g.desc: TUSB320LAI presents sink terminations and reports advertised current over I2C. No PD.

g.text: USB 2.0 data to the module; duplicate contacts joined. TPD2E2U06 on D+/D-, CC and VBUS is ESD only, not overvoltage cutoff.

g.desc: USB 2.0 data to the module; duplicate contacts joined. TPD2E2U06 on D+/D-, CC and VBUS is ESD only, not overvoltage cutoff.

g.text: Divider and Schmitt inverters give USB_ABSENT (gates SERVICE_OK) and USB_PRESENT (to MCU).

g.desc: Divider and Schmitt inverters give USB_ABSENT (gates SERVICE_OK) and USB_PRESENT (to MCU).

g.text: USB-C 5 V SINK - NO PD, DATA TO MODULE, CHARGER NOT YET CONNECTED

g.desc: USB-C 5 V SINK - NO PD, DATA TO MODULE, CHARGER NOT YET CONNECTED

g.text: VBUS fault protection and current limit belong to the charger step. No duplicate Rd: the CC controller contains the sink terminations.

g.desc: VBUS fault protection and current limit belong to the charger step. No duplicate Rd: the CC controller contains the sink terminations.

g.text: Route the USB 2.0 pair short and matched, directly to the module.
